cards.title: Family Sexual Abuse: How to Respond
cards.body: If a family member discloses childhood sexual abuse, prioritize making them feel safe and heard at their own pace. Assess any ongoing danger the perpetrator may pose to younger family members and seek appropriate support.

cards.title: Empty Nest: Managing the Emotional Transition
cards.body: Parents often experience unexpected grief when their children leave for university, despite knowing it's a natural life stage. Acknowledging these complex emotions rather than denying them can help with the adjustment process.

cards.title: Bringing Children to Music Festivals
cards.body: Families with young children can successfully enjoy music festivals together, adding vibrancy rather than detracting from the experience. Toddlers and festivals aren't mutually exclusive—parents can create meaningful memories alongside their kids.

cards.title: Climate Change Stress on Family Life
cards.body: Extreme heat and climate impacts add significant stress to parents already stretched thin managing work and home. Understanding how climate change affects family dynamics is crucial for modern parenting.

cards.title: Why Rewards Undermine Child Motivation
cards.body: While rewards secure compliance from children, they can actually weaken intrinsic motivation once the reward disappears. Research shows the long-term impact of reward systems on genuine motivation development.

cards.title: Immune System Changes in Children
cards.body: When a child changes behavior suddenly, parents typically look for psychological causes—but the immune system may be the overlooked culprit. Recent studies suggest immune responses deserve consideration alongside behavioral assessment.

cards.title: Back-to-School: Saving on Family Costs
cards.body: Parents can reduce back-to-school expenses through baby banks, supermarket deals, and community resources. Budget-friendly options exist to ease the financial burden of new school terms.

cards.title: Teen Drug Use and Academic Pressure
cards.body: Chinese teens are misusing prescription drugs as an escape from fear of failure and academic stress. The pressure to succeed is pushing vulnerable students toward dangerous coping mechanisms.

cards.title: Recognizing Hidden Strengths in Children
cards.body: Weaknesses children struggle with throughout life may mask their signature strengths and potential. Parents can help by reframing perceived limitations as indicators of deeper capabilities.
